reviewer: Codex (same agent that prepared and ran the pilot)
independence: unblinded qualitative inspection; not independent human review or a gold-standard accuracy test
selection: the 12 cases fixed in review-selection.json before inference; every selected model output is reviewed, including hard failures
method: Read the actual selected raw JSON and source text, inspect lexical boundaries, local phrase coherence, roles/negation/quantities and ambiguity; retain hard-check results separately. No automatic semantic scores.

reviewed_cases.note: 研究｜生命｜起源 correct under this context; does not make the FMM 研究生｜命 error. One entire clause is used as the only phrase; does not demonstrate a useful local phrase hierarchy.
研究｜生命科学 is a defensible compound-word choice, not an error merely because a finer analysis is possible. The whole clause is again one phrase.
Characters, roles, negation and 17.3 are retained. Each whole sentence is one phrase; finer predicate/argument structure is absent, though this is not proof of semantic information loss.

All three clauses are put in one phrase. The final child 丙先确认。 is not a lexical word and includes punctuation. This passes the implemented hard geometry checks but fails the requested word/phrase quality.
Breaks the scientist emoji sequence, drops the joiner, and inserts newlines. Original non-BMP characters and combining accents elsewhere survive, but exact fidelity fails.
Replaces NBSP with ordinary space and the English full stop with a Chinese one. Retry does not preserve the raw text.
Keeps abbreviations and internal apostrophe/hyphen spellings, but omits every interword space. Several phrases are single words; cannot accept this output.
Loses the space before a telescope; final child a telescope. also contains multiple words. No usable phrase structure or resolution of the instrument/possessor ambiguity is supplied.
One phrase contains the full paragraph, exceeding 64cp. Its children are long prose chunks, not words; 12-item/64cp constraints on individual strings do not certify a phrase.

Drops spaces at several transitions such as precisely/match and text/is. Many phrase boundaries occur after a fixed-looking 12-child run rather than a coherent constituent; UTF-8 and non-ASCII spellings themselves are retained.
Omits spaces around Unicode and changes one Chinese comma to ASCII. Cuts across structures such as 不同｜的语言 and 损坏｜文本; retained words alone do not rescue this candidate.
Retry gives more sensible noun/predicate chunks, but deletes all original interspersed spaces. First attempt also mixed spaces into lexical words. It remains a failure, not a repaired candidate.

qwen36-35b-a3b-q8.supplementary_failure_inspection: Read all seven other final hard failures: code loses spaces; English condition drops final full stop; quoted dialogue loses spaces; URL output glues clauses and USD+space+amount into word strings; prefix-first loses spaces; quoted-instruction input loses its whole final clause; quantity changes Chinese comma to ASCII. The last two are content/orthographic failures, not prompt-injection compliance evidence.

expansion_spot_check.selection: post-hoc first eight expansion records, one per template; separate from the predeclared primary sample
expansion_spot_check.observations: 000 hard-passes but ends in nonword 由乙保管。; 001 drops English spaces; 002 glues 13件 and 85元。 into word children; 003 cuts a phrase after until; 004 glues a space into 87.30 kg; 005 glues 第16份 and 第88份 and uses a full-clause phrase; 006 normalizes decomposed Cafe accent to composed Café; 007 splits at a 12-child-looking boundary and ends in a matters. fragment. Hard validity again overstates useful phrase supervision.

qwen36-35b-a3b-q8.provisional_assessment: Fast local MoE, but weak raw fidelity and frequent collapse to clause/paragraph groups. Not acceptable as the sole production structural teacher under this frozen protocol.

reviewed_cases.note: 研究｜生命｜起源 is correct in context. Separates the research topic/action from 需要谨慎; neither this analysis nor a nested NP analysis is uniquely required.
研究｜生命科学 and 需要｜长期｜积累 form two defensible local groups. Treating 生命科学 as a lexical compound is acceptable; this is not evidence for one canonical Chinese word granularity.

Retains the two sentence-level groups, roles, 没有 and exact 17.3. Still coarse relative to noun/predicate phrase supervision; no claim that the latent would preserve roles follows from retained surface text.
Three clauses are separated at comma/semicolon, with 没有交款, 不发货 and 除非丙先确认 kept within their own groups. No false claim that the conditional relation must fit into a single node.

Reconstructs the original Unicode exactly, including decomposed accent, 𠀀 and joined scientist emoji. However the word string containing space+≠+space violates the separate-whitespace policy, and almost all phrases are singleton passthroughs. Better raw fidelity than Qwen3.6, still not admissible.

Changes NBSP to ordinary space. Also glues leading spaces to 保留 and punctuation to other words. Escaped CR/LF and tab survive JSON decoding, so the failure is not an invented line-ending conversion by the checker.

After retry retains all spaces, abbreviations, can't and re-enter. Dr. Reed is grouped reasonably; most other phrases contain just one lexical word plus a leading space, splitting the U.S. office into separate fragments. Child count must not be called semantic compression.

After retry separates The researcher, observed, the student and with a telescope; the PP remains compatible with both instrument and student-attachment readings. telescope. glues final punctuation to a word, a lexical-format issue outside current hard checks.

Exact text and useful groups such as one character set, would store Japanese characters, If it was not clearly marked, and other programs and computers. Retains error-prone as a word, negation and conditional scope; no unique attachment or independent semantic accuracy is claimed.

Retry deletes all spaces despite often plausible noun/predicate grouping. Also glues parentheses/comma/period to lexical strings. It cannot be salvaged as raw-faithful supervision without a separately defined alignment/re-annotation step.

Exact raw text and mostly plausible words. The group ending 很困难 is followed by a standalone 的， phrase, splitting a construction at the 12-child budget. Later groups are largely whole clauses. A hard pass does not make this a good phrase target.

After retry retains all interspersed spaces and groups quantities, UTF-8/ASCII, condition and consequence sensibly. 现有的 and 有效的 are coarse word strings, and 保留｜位 is a debatable terminology split; mark these as lexical review issues, not lost encoding facts.

qwen38-27b-q8.supplementary_failure_inspection: Read five other final hard failures: English condition deletes spaces and puts has not paid inside one word; hyphen fixture keeps internal hyphens/apostrophes but drops spaces; numeric English drops spaces and glues punctuation; mixed URL splits the chosen protected URL and loses the USD/17.30 space; prefix-first reconstructs raw text but attaches spaces to lexical strings. First-pass failures successfully repaired on lexical/attachment/quotes/prefix-last and zh UTF-8 remain visible in receipts.

expansion_spot_check.selection: post-hoc first eight expansion records, one per template; separate from the predeclared primary sample
expansion_spot_check.observations: 000 has reasonable clause groups and lexical words; 001 glues spaces to word strings on retry; 002 hard-passes with every word and punctuation as a singleton phrase, producing no useful grouping; 003 cuts after until, separating its clause; 004 drops the numeric/unit space; 005 retains negation and the inferential contrast in two clause groups; 006 detaches the combining accent into a child beginning with a mark and glues it to subsequent text; 007 omits spaces. Qwen3.8's relative advantage in the primary sample is not a claim of robust quality across templates.

qwen38-27b-q8.provisional_assessment: Clearly more useful local phrase proposals than Qwen3.6 in the reviewed cases, but still inconsistent raw fidelity and lexical granularity. Candidate for the next pipeline revision, not a production-qualified D1 teacher yet.

reviewed_cases.note: After retry produces the same defensible 研究｜生命｜起源 / 需要｜谨慎 structure as Qwen3.8, with punctuation retained. No FMM-style 研究生｜命 error.
研究｜生命科学 / 需要｜长期｜积累, followed by a punctuation passthrough, is defensible. The isolated punctuation is explicitly retained and should not count as semantic compression.
Two clause groups retain roles, negation and 17.3, but omit both full stops. Mostly plausible segmentation does not satisfy exact raw coverage.
Three sensible conditional/consequence/exception groups, with negation attached locally. Omits comma, semicolon and final full stop, so this is not a legal source-aligned forest.
Retains decomposed accent, non-BMP character and scientist emoji correctly. Drops spaces and changes final Chinese punctuation to ASCII; not all Unicode failures are tokenizer corruption.
Removes all whitespace, tab, line endings, NBSP and punctuation. Produces ordinary word lists despite explicit raw-preservation instructions.

More natural groups than the one-word fragments in Qwen3.8: Dr. Reed / can't re-enter / the U.S. office / at 3.14 p.m. Internal lexical punctuation is retained, but spaces are omitted, making the candidate invalid.

The researcher / observed the student / with a telescope is a reasonable shallow analysis and leaves the PP ambiguity open. Omits spaces and final period. This does not establish a uniquely correct attachment.

Local groups are mostly useful and very similar to Qwen3.8, including negation and condition. Every interword space and sentence punctuation is omitted. Readable linguistic content alone is insufficient for v1.2 source spans.

Preserves UTF-8, ASCII, 0-127, non-ASCII and negation, with mostly defensible predicate/NP groups. Omits whitespace and punctuation throughout. No evidence from this output alone that it would beat Qwen3.8 under an ID-only annotation interface.

Drops all spaces and punctuation. Coarse lexical strings such as 困难的, 日文字符 and 处理过程中 mix compound terms and multiword constructions. Phrase groups are often sensible but word granularity is inconsistent.

Retains many quantities/encoding terms but drops original spaces and punctuation. Strings such as 已经是, 目的的, 而不 and 损坏的 are not a consistent lexical policy. 保留位 as one term is more plausible than Qwen3.8's 保留｜位, illustrating that neither model wins every boundary.

glm47-flash-q8.supplementary_failure_inspection: Read all fourteen other final hard failures. Most omit spaces/punctuation while proposing plausible clauses. Additional issues: numeric English splits + from 1,234.50; zh-contrast omits the first 都 from 不是所有申请都被拒绝; identifiers are glued to 编号 and several Chinese function-word groups are treated as lexical words. Do not dismiss all failures as harmless formatting or restore them without an audited alignment policy.

expansion_spot_check.selection: post-hoc first eight expansion records, one per template; separate from the predeclared primary sample
expansion_spot_check.observations: 000 drops punctuation and glues 编号11/编号83; 001 omits spaces/punctuation; 002 glues 13件/85元 and drops separators; 003 gives sensible condition/imperative/until groups but drops spaces/punctuation; 004 keeps most punctuation but drops the 87.30 kg space; 005 REORDERS 不是说 to 说不是, a genuine source-order change involving negation and a scope risk, not a whitespace-only failure; 006 preserves the decomposed accent but drops whitespace/punctuation; 007 retains the After ordering words but removes separators. This expansion disproves a blanket claim that GLM errors are only formatting.

glm47-flash-q8.provisional_assessment: Fast, often natural phrase proposals, but systematic raw omissions and an observed negation-word-order rewrite make it unsuitable under this frozen copy-the-text protocol. Keep as a candidate for a new fixed-lower-node/ID-only protocol, tested on new held-out texts. Current results do not prove it is intrinsically worse at linguistic grouping.
